newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela oil basket off 54 cents in wk to $21.30.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela oil basket off 54 cents in wk to $21.30.

text.p: The average export price for Venezuela's basket of oil crudes and products dipped 54 cents to $21.30 per barrel from $21.84 on October 4, the Energy and Mines Ministry said.
Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said Venezuela's oil price was "performing well", despite this week's drop, which was "market-driven".
The average price for the year so far is $17.55 per barrel, the ministry statement said, above state-owned oil company PdVSA's annual estimate of $17.20.
Venezuela's oil export price averaged $14.84 per barrel last year compared to $13.23 per barrel in 1994.
Oil accounts for some 40 percent of government revenues.
